messages:
harper: CI build error: markdownlint complaining about `MD041/heading-start-left` in migration guide after the recent snippet reflow PR.
nate: which file/line?
harper: docs/migration/v2-to-v3.md around the examples section. the heading had a code fence directly above without a blank line.
elaine: markdownlint wants headings to start at leftmost column (no leading spaces). i think the auto-formatter wrapped the snippet and added two spaces.
docs-bot: markdownlint: MD041 in docs/migration/v2-to-v3.md: line 210
sam: quick fix: add a blank line between the fenced code block and the heading, and run prettier on the file. i'll open a tiny PR.
harper: also add a comment to the PR about why the blank line matters; we've seen this crop up in earlier PRs.
nate: I'm wondering if we should enable the rule in CI and add a docs-linting checklist in PR templates to catch earlier.
elaine: good call. small RFC: enable markdownlint rule MD041 in docs CI, but add an auto-fix step for formatting. leaning toward a follow-up PR to the docs infra.
sam: PR 6901: fix blank line + run prettier. docs-linkcheck unaffected.
docs-bot: PR 6901 linkcheck:  no changes
harper: merging after CI passes. will open infra ticket to enable MD041 as blocking later.
